Stage.LogText: {=da_log_4_1}The long saga nears its culmination. With {Kalan_Link} restored to the bellows, the master smith {EfsaneviDemirci_Link} bids you hasten to the workshop for the final tempering of the ancestral blade.

{=da_log_4_2}To awaken the soul of the folded Star Iron, the masters require the sacred 'Heart's Fire' ritual. Procure 50,000 denars for the rare oils and crucible catalysts, then deliver the sum to the smiths.

{=da_log_4_3}The anvils have fallen silent. Steam rises from the tempering trough. The Covenant Sword shines with celestial brilliance! Speak with {EfsaneviDemirci_Link} to determine who shall bear this legendary weapon.
{=da_log_4_4}You claimed the Covenant Sword as your clan's sacred heirloom! Its unmatched balance and razor keenness will lead your bloodline to dominion across all Calradia.

{=da_log_4_5}You presented the peerless Covenant Sword to your sovereign, King {IttifakKrali_Link}. The gesture shakes the royal court; songs of your unshakeable chivalry and devotion resound throughout the realm.

DialogNode.Text: {=da_miras_p_giris}The bellows roar like dragons today, master. Is the steel ready for the final fold?

{=da_miras_dlg_1}Welcome, noble warlord. For weeks my brother {Kalan_Link} and I have folded the celestial steel a thousand times over the anvil. The blade is straight and flawless. But to breathe an eternal soul into the metal, we must ignite the 'Heart's Fire'. This sacred ritual requires rare alchemical fluxes and royal crucible catalysts worth 50,000 gold.
{=da_m4_p_sorgu_rituel}What is this 'Heart's Fire' ritual? Why does ordinary coal not suffice for this steel, master?
{=da_m4_p_sorgu_maliyet}What is the toll of such a rite, master? My clan's treasury stands ready to bring this legend to fruition.
{=da_m4_p_sorgu_soy}Generations of our bloodline have waited for this dawn, master. Whatever the furnace demands, our house shall provide.
{=da_miras_ertele}I cannot deal with this right now. We will speak later.

{=da_m4_npc_lore_rituel}Because Star Iron fell from the firmament, it scorns earthly heat, child. The Heart's Fire burns with distilled quicksilver, rare brimstone salts, and consecrated oils; its flame blazes radiant azure. When steel is quenched in that crucible, its grains fuse forever, and the blade acquires an unbreakable soul.

{=da_m4_npc_lore_maliyet}Procuring these rare fluxes and royal catalysts demands 50,000 gold. A sum that could equip an entire royal cohort, yet the sword it births will wield the might to bend whole armies to its will.

{=da_m4_npc_lore_soy}Your ancestors look down from the halls of eternity with pride, child. Fifty thousand gold is the earthly cost to unlock heavenly power. When azure fire blazes, your house's name will be inscribed upon the stars.
{=da_m4_p_sorgu_zaman}How long does it take to bank the crucibles and stoke the azure flame, master?
{=da_m4_p_sorgu_kader}Once the blade emerges from the flames, who shall hold the right to dictate its destiny?
{=da_miras_ertele}I cannot deal with this right now. We will speak later.
{=da_m4_npc_detay_zaman}Once the gold is delivered, my brother Kalan and I need but a few hours to blend the salts. The coals are already humming.
{=da_m4_npc_detay_kader}Yours alone, warlord! It is sealed with your bloodline's covenant. Whether it crowns your heirs or seals your sovereign's realm, the choice rests in your hands.
{=da_m4_p_tutum_soy}For the eternal renown of my lineage and my ancestors' covenant, 50,000 gold is a light burden. I shall gather the coin and return to your forge.
{=da_m4_p_tutum_kudret}No tribute is too steep for a blade that will shake Calradia to its core. I will fetch the gold; prepare the crucible!
{=da_miras_ertele}I cannot deal with this right now. We will speak later.
{=da_m4_npc_hazirlik}May your word prove sturdier than tempered steel, child. Amass the 50,000 gold while we bank the crucibles. When this flame erupts, all Calradia shall bear witness!
{=da_miras_p_giris_2}Let the crucible be stoked, master. I have returned with our offering.
{=da_miras_dlg_2}Do you bring the gold to kindle the Heart's Fire?
{=da_miras_p2}Here is the 50,000 gold. Kindle the flame and quench the blade!
{=da_miras_p3}I have not yet amassed the full sum. Keep the embers banked; I shall return shortly.
{=da_miras_kaynak_ertele}I cannot deal with this right now. We will speak later.

{=da_miras_dlg_3}The flames leap blue and white! Hear the twin hammers ring as incandescent sparks cascade across the anvil... It is finished! Behold the Covenant Blade! Speak to me once more, warrior, for a fateful choice remains.
{=da_miras_p_giris_3}The blade is breathtaking. What final counsel do you give, master?

{=da_miras_dlg_4}The Covenant Sword... The purest, most lethal steel these hands shall ever fashion. A weapon worthy of reshaping empires. Will you bind its glory to your clan's eternal bloodline, or will you offer it as a gift of supreme fealty to your liege lord?
{=da_m4_k_p_sorgu_klan}My house's sigil gleams upon the pommel. This weapon was kneaded with my clan's blood; can it truly belong to anyone else?
{=da_m4_k_p_sorgu_kral}Were I to present this blade to my sovereign... Would it not serve the realm's peace and elevate our house beside the throne?
{=da_m4_k_p_sorgu_bilek}Does true dominion spring from crowns and thrones, or from the warrior who wields the cold edge?
{=da_miras_karar_ertele}I cannot deal with this right now. We will speak later.

{=da_m4_k_npc_lore_klan}If you keep it for your bloodline, your heirs shall reap conquests beneath its edge for centuries; your name will echo across royal halls. You will carve your destiny with your own right arm.

{=da_m4_k_npc_lore_kral}If you offer it to your liege lord, your clan will claim the highest seat at the royal council; the monarch's gratitude and your political renown will know no bounds. The choice rests in your heart.

{=da_m4_k_npc_lore_bilek}Thrones crumble and crowns rust away, but legendary steel endures. Whether bound to your banner or gifted to a sovereign, it is the wielder's honor that gives the steel its soul.
{=da_m4_k_p_sorgu_ustagorus}And what says your own heart, master? As a craftsman who turned gray before this forge, in whose hands do you wish this masterpiece to shine?
{=da_miras_karar_ertele}I cannot deal with this right now. We will speak later.
{=da_m4_k_npc_lore_ustagorus}Steel has no king, warrior; it knows only the will of whoever grips its hilt. My hammer has finished its work; the final verse of this legend belongs to you.
{=da_miras_p4}This sword was bought with my clan's blood and sweat. It shall remain our eternal heirloom and the standard beneath which my heirs shall conquer!

DialogNode.DisabledHint: {=da_hint_vassal_req}Must be a Vassal of an Empire or Kingdom
DialogNode.Text: {=da_miras_p5}I shall present this peerless blade to my sovereign king. In the monarch's hands, it shall elevate our clan to the right hand of the throne!
{=da_miras_karar_ertele}I cannot deal with this right now. We will speak later.

{=da_m4_npc_sonuc_klan}Then take it, true Heir of the Covenant! May this celestial steel split shields, shatter armor, and guide your heirs to rule Calradia! Grip its hilt and wear it with honor, warlord!

{=da_m4_npc_sonuc_kral}A noble and far-sighted decision! A weapon worthy of an emperor's hand, resting in this velvet scabbard emblazoned with golden sigils. Present this to King {IttifakKrali_Link}. His gratitude shall echo in songs for a hundred winters!
